notes: Standard WooCommerce markup (Bricks builder theme) on top of a WooCommerce product loop, so class names like 'woocommerce-Price-amount' are reliable even though headings/wrappers use generic Bricks 'dynamic' classes. All 33 products render on one page ('Näytetään kaikki 33 tulosta') - no pagination. Stock status is NOT a descendant selector: WooCommerce puts 'instock' or 'outofstock' directly as a class on the li.product container itself, so in_stock is null here - check for presence of class 'instock' vs 'outofstock' on the product_container element. Ticket 18: 'onbackorder' maps to out_of_stock; the product page for such an item says 'Ei varastossa, vain jälkitoimituksena'. No listing page seen carries outofstock (0 of 143 cards on the Pokemon search, 0 of 40 on /kauppa), so treat this site as tracked in-stock-only.
